pkgmetadata.longdescription: Noctalia Greeter is a minimal login greeter for greetd that matches the look and feel of Noctalia Shell. It lets you pick a user, enter your password, choose a Wayland session, and pick a color scheme. It bundles a wlroots compositor (noctalia-greeter-compositor) and greetd should run the noctalia-greeter-session wrapper. No Qt or GTK dependency.
